description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides a unified API client for the DigitalT3 Weekly Report Platform. It includes functions for making HTTP requests to various backend services, handling authentication tokens, error normalization, and exposing specific API endpoints such as auth, user, reports, blockers, dashboard, ai, notifications, and export.
external_files: process.env (environment variables in Node.js or bundler environment)

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables or defaults to '/api'.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with default headers, token handling, and error normalization.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Sets or clears the in-memory authentication token.

methods.name: setExtraHeaders
methods.description: Sets global headers to be included in all requests.

methods.name: getExtraHeaders
methods.description: Returns the current global headers.

methods.name: auth.register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and name.

methods.name: auth.login
methods.description: Logs in a user with email and password, optionally persisting the token.

methods.name: user.getCurrentUser
methods.description: Fetches the profile of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: user.updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile fields.

methods.name: reports.listReports
methods.description: Lists reports with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: reports.createReport
methods.description: Creates a new report.

methods.name: reports.getReport
methods.description: Retrieves a report by ID.

methods.name: reports.updateReport
methods.description: Updates a report by ID.

methods.name: reports.deleteReport
methods.description: Deletes a report by ID.

methods.name: blockers.listBlockers
methods.description: Lists blockers with optional filters.

methods.name: blockers.createBlocker
methods.description: Creates a new blocker.

methods.name: blockers.updateBlocker
methods.description: Updates a blocker by ID.

methods.name: blockers.deleteBlocker
methods.description: Deletes a blocker by ID.

methods.name: dashboard.getDashboard
methods.description: Fetches dashboard data, with fallback for singular/plural route.

methods.name: ai.getSummaryByReportId
methods.description: Fetches AI-generated summary for a report.

methods.name: notifications.listNotifications
methods.description: Lists notifications for the current user.

methods.name: exports.exportReports
methods.description: Exports reports as a file (CSV or PDF), returning a Blob and filename.
